name: tw-lvr-cli
description: 台灣實價登錄 CLI — latest building-level Taiwan real-price (內政部實價登錄) transactions as clean JSON. Deterministic CLI + library + Agent Skill, packaged as a Claude/Codex-compatible plugin. No server, no model in the loop. Requires the chrome-headless-shell browser binary (npx playwright install chromium-headless-shell).
